verdict.rationale: An email client could reasonably offer a public API with UI parity, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only inbound integrations: Shortwave's AI can connect to external MCP servers, Zapier and Tasklet. Those are client-side and adjacent capabilities, not a Shortwave API, and probes for OpenAPI/Swagger specs all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
